title: Audio and video elements
learningObjectives: Use audio and video elements accessibly and safely.

understand.concept: audio and video provide native media playback. Add controls so users can play, pause, seek and adjust volume. Avoid unexpected autoplay.
understand.whyItMatters: Native controls provide familiar interaction and user control.
understand.analogy: Like a built-in player, although browser codec support still matters.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy explains the idea only; browser behaviour depends on semantics, resource availability and format support.

explain.narrative: audio and video provide native media playback. Add controls so users can play, pause, seek and adjust volume. Avoid unexpected autoplay.

examples.code: <video controls width="480"><source src="lesson.mp4" type="video/mp4">Your browser does not support video.</video>
examples.explanation: Inspect each attribute and test with a media file you own or are permitted to use.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser renders the element when its resource exists and the format is supported.

practise.guidedTask: Add controls and a fallback message to a video element.
practise.independentTask: Build an accessible media section for a fictional learning page and explain your choices.
hints: Check the browser console and network panel if a resource fails.
Do not embed untrusted content without reviewing its origin and permissions.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Audio and video elements</title></head><body>
<video controls width="480"><source src="lesson.mp4" type="video/mp4">Your browser does not support video.</video>
</body></html>
practice.resetCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Audio and video elements</title></head><body>
<video controls width="480"><source src="lesson.mp4" type="video/mp4">Your browser does not support video.</video>
</body></html>

questions.prompt: Which attribute displays native playback controls?
questions.explanation: Choose the semantic element or attribute designed for this purpose.

questions.prompt: Does every image need long descriptive alt text?
questions.explanation: Alt depends on purpose; decorative images use an empty alt attribute.
